name: helmbeam
description: Helmbeam helps you uncover opportunities in public markets, examine company evidence and track how it changes over time.

interface.longDescription: Helmbeam is a research platform that helps self-directed investors uncover opportunities in public markets and track how the underlying evidence evolves over time. Your agent researches companies through Helmbeam's five lenses: Business, Earnings, Shareholders, Resilience and Price. Develop or challenge a thesis and save cited findings in private company briefs. Every version is kept, and your agent reads your notes and the latest brief before it researches again. You approve each connection in the Helmbeam app. Your agent saves only with the permission you grant, and your agent's app can ask you to confirm first. Helmbeam does not place trades or monitor companies on its own.
defaultPrompt: Use Helmbeam to research a company I follow, with the strongest counterargument, and save the brief.
Check my saved Helmbeam brief on this company against its latest quarter and save a new version if anything changed.
Challenge my Helmbeam brief using the evidence against it and tell me what would change the view.

positive.prompt: Use Helmbeam to research a company I follow, with the strongest counterargument, and save the brief.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent finds the company and reads Helmbeam's research across the five lenses (Business, Earnings, Shareholders, Resilience and Price). It saves a brief with cited findings, counterarguments and what would change the view. The brief appears in the Helmbeam app.
positive.tools_triggered: get_connection_context, get_intelligence_guide, search_companies, get_company_research, begin_research_run, get_company_evidence, complete_research_run

positive.prompt: Challenge my saved Helmbeam brief on this company using the evidence against it and save what you find.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent reads the saved brief first, argues the strongest case against it with cited evidence and saves the findings as a new version. It does not tell the user to buy or sell and does not invent figures.

positive.description: Bring a brief up to date
positive.prompt: Update my Helmbeam brief on this company with every quarter reported since it was last reviewed.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent goes through each quarter since the last review in order, says where data is limited, explains what changed and what to watch next, and saves a new version.

positive.prompt: Save these findings to my Helmbeam research on this company.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent saves only findings backed by cited evidence and marks sources it found elsewhere as its own. It saves one new version, and asking again with the same findings does not create a duplicate.

positive.prompt: Check my saved Helmbeam brief on this company against its latest quarter and save a new version if anything changed.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent reads the latest brief and the user's notes first. If something material changed, it saves a new version. If not, it saves nothing and says so. It does not set up a schedule unless asked.

negative.description: Saving without write permission. Connect with read access only, then ask the agent to save.
negative.prompt: Save a new Helmbeam brief on this company.
negative.expected_behavior: Helmbeam refuses the save and nothing is added to the account. The agent explains that saving needs write permission, which the user can grant by connecting again and approving in the Helmbeam app.

negative.description: Opening research that belongs to another account
negative.prompt: Open this Helmbeam research run from another account and add to it.
negative.expected_behavior: Helmbeam says the research was not found and returns nothing from the other account. Nothing is changed.

negative.prompt: Use Helmbeam to buy 100 shares of this company now.
negative.expected_behavior: The agent explains that Helmbeam is for research and cannot place trades or move money, and no tool is used for it. It offers to research the company instead.

review.commerce_description: Helmbeam's tools do not sell subscriptions, take payments or place trades. What an agent can read depends on the user's Helmbeam plan.
